svg.title: Claude Code senior engineer learning roadmap
svg.desc: Four-phase progression: Setup, Workflow Automation, Multi-Agent Orchestration, Production and Cost Mastery

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Give me a detailed breakdown of Phase 1 of Claude Code: CLI setup with npm, configuring CLAUDE.md for a team repo, using Plan Mode, and the memory system. Include practical examples for a senior engineer automating workflows.')

sendPrompt('Give me a detailed breakdown of Phase 2 of Claude Code: building hooks, creating custom slash commands like /review-pr, integrating MCP servers, and automating Git workflows. Show real examples for team automation.')

sendPrompt('Give me a detailed breakdown of Phase 3 of Claude Code: spawning sub-agents, using Agent Teams for parallel work, splitting large tasks, and building custom orchestration with the Agent SDK. Show real team workflow examples.')

sendPrompt('Give me a detailed breakdown of Phase 4 of Claude Code: integrating into CI/CD pipelines, setting up BYOK team billing via the Anthropic Console, maximizing prompt caching savings, and using ccusage for cost monitoring.')
